zapmail_api_key.title: Zapmail API key
zapmail_api_key.description:
Zapmail authenticates with a single API key sent in the x-auth-zapmail header
(raw token, not Bearer). Get it at Dashboard > Settings > Integrations > API.
Set it in the ZAPMAIL_API_KEY environment variable.
